scripts.build: node -e "fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node22 --log-level=warning --outfile=dist/index.cjs && node -e "for (const file of fs.readdirSync('dist', { recursive: true })) if (file.endsWith('.d.ts')) fs.cpSync(path.join('dist', file), path.join('dist', 'cjs', file)); fs.writeFileSync('dist/cjs/package.json', JSON.stringify({ type: 'commonjs' }))"
scripts.prepack: node -e "for (const file of ['README.md', 'LICENSE']) fs.copyFileSync('../../' + file, file)"
